evidence.summary: SASTIND and the Ministry of Education named Wuhan University in 2016 as one of 16 universities they co-build for 2016–2020, to support defence-specialty disciplines and majors, defence key discipline laboratories and training for the defence industry.

In 2015 Wuhan University signed a military–civil fusion framework agreement and ten specific cooperation agreements with the PLA Information Engineering University, and in 2023 a talent cooperation agreement with the PLA’s National University of Defense Technology.
